{#xagt} # Discussion

{#kntk} Our study indicated that silencing PinX1 enhances radiosensitivity and antitumor-immunity of RT by enhancing IR-induced telomere dysfunction, therefore improving the antitumor efficiency of radioimmunotherapy.

{#if83} PinX1 was initially identified as a telomerase-binding protein with a highly potent inhibitor of telomerase activity [@w:w27]. However, many studies have suggested that PinX1 positively regulates telomere maintenance and promotes genome stability in tumor cells [@w:w28]. The role of PinX1 in tumorigenesis and progression varies widely among cancer types [@w:w29]. For NSCLC, previous studies have shown that PinX1 inhibits tumor cell proliferation [@w:w30]. Our previous studies have shown that the high expression of PinX1 induced radioresistance through promoting telomere maintenance and chromosome stabilization, and targeting PinX1 significantly enhances radiosensitivity via increasing IR-induced telomere dysfunction in ESCC [@w:w31]. In the in vitro experimental part of our study (including colony formation assay and CCK-8 assay), knockdown of PinX1 also increased cell proliferation of tumor cells to a certain extent, however, when combined with RT, cell proliferation appeared significantly downregulated relative to RT alone. {#dcyd} # Background

{#sfdo} Non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) accounts for roughly 85% of all lung cancer cases and substantially contributes to cancer deaths worldwide . Both immune checkpoint blockade (ICB) immunotherapy and radiotherapy are first-line treatments for NSCLC. For locally advanced NSCLC, chemoradiation combined with ICB has become the standard treatment. [@w:w1] However, the curative efficacy of radio-immunotherapy is still suboptimal, and radioresistance remains a significant barrier to improving the antitumor-immunity of IR, limiting the survival benefit of NSCLC from radiotherapy–immunotherapy combinations [@w:w2]. Therefore, there is an urgent need to investigate prospective combination modalities to enhance the antitumor immunity of IR.

{#r8dd} Radiotherapy can elicit significant immunostimulatory effects, including triggering immunogenic cell death (ICD) and improving the tumor immune microenvironment (TIME) [@w:w3]. However, there needs to be more strategies that could effectively boost the antitumor-immunity of radiotherapy in clinical settings due to inadequately elucidated mechanisms. The prevailing view suggests that radiation directly induces DNA damage and micronucleus formation in tumor cells, leading to DNA single- and double-strand breaks (DSBs) [@w:w4]. {#lmzm} We also found that silencing PinX1 combined with radioimmunotherapy dramatically promoted M1 macrophage polarization in NSCLC. We know that in lung cancer, macrophages are a major component of the TIME [@w:w48]. There are two main phenotypes of macrophages, pro-inflammatory (M1-type) macrophages and anti-inflammatory (M2-type) macrophages [@w:w49]. M1-type macrophages can kill tumor cells ⟦by⟧ ⟦direct⟧ cytotoxicity or ⟦by⟧ antibody-dependent cytotoxicity, while pro-tumourigenic M2-type macrophages ⟦are⟧ committed to tumor growth, invasion and metastasis [@w:w50]. Therefore, reprogramming of tumor-associated macrophages from M2-type to M1-type is critical for alleviating the immunosuppressive state of the TIME and controlling tumor growth. Other than induced ICD, optimized radiation can also promote the conversion of M2 macrophages to M1 in the TIME [@w:w51]. These findings may explain why targeting PinX1 could improve the tumor-suppressive immune microenvironment.

ops.markdown: IR was initially thought to kill tumor cells mainly by direct DNA damage [@w:w32]. RT is now increasingly recognized as an "in situ vaccine" that activates host antitumor immunity by inducing ICD and optimizing the TIME, for instance by regulating MHC-I and intercellular adhesion molecule (I-CAM) expression on vascular endothelial cells [@w:w33]. Accordingly, RT has been combined with immunotherapy. However, radioresistance and immune tolerance limit the efficacy of radioimmunotherapy, and roughly 2/3 of NSCLC patients still experience tumor progression, so a safe and effective strategy to enhance radiosensitivity and the immunostimulatory effects of IR is urgently needed [@w:w34]. Telomere dysfunction impairs the repair of radiation-induced DSBs, and the resulting free DNA fragments are captured by DCs and activate STING-dependent type I interferon signaling, contributing to radioresistance and immunoresistance [@w:w35]. Misplaced DNA generated from DSBs or faulty DDR can likewise induce antitumor immunity by activating pattern recognition receptors in malignant cells [@w:w36]. Targeting telomerase/telomeres is therefore a promising way to boost the antitumor immunity of RT. In this study, silencing PinX1 impaired telomerase function in telomere maintenance in vitro and in vivo, thereby promoting the immune-activating effects of IR and enhancing the antitumor efficacy of radioimmunotherapy in NSCLC cells. Consistent with the clinical benefit of radioimmunotherapy, Zhou et al. reported that in 381 patients with locally advanced, unresectable stage III NSCLC whose disease had not progressed after concurrent or sequential chemoradiotherapy, consolidation with the anti-PD-L1 antibody sugemalimab prolonged median progression-free survival to 9·0 months (95% CI 8·1-14·1) versus 5·8 months (95% CI 4·2-6·6) with placebo (p=0·0026) [@c:c2714804].

**改了什么**

1. **开头句**：「Previous researches have suggested the mechanism by which IR killing tumor cells could be directly damaging their DNA」→「IR was initially thought to kill tumor cells mainly by directly damaging their DNA」——去掉 “the mechanism by which” 这类冗长结构。
2. **第二句**：「There is now a growing recognition that RT can act as an “in situ vaccine” to activate host anti-tumor immunity, which cause tumor cells to ICD, as well as optimize TIME…」→「RT is now increasingly recognized as an “in situ vaccine” that activates host antitumor immunity by inducing ICD and optimizing the TIME…」。

4. **端粒功能与 STING 那句**：「can interfere with the properness of radiation-induced DSBs repair, thus giving rise to large amounts of DNA damage…」→「impairs the repair of radiation-induced DSBs, and the resulting free DNA fragments…」；并把 “type I interferon activation” 改为 “type I interferon signaling”，避免与后面 “leading to…” 的衔接重复。
5. **模式识别受体那句**：「It is now well appreciated that misplaced DNA… through activating primitive pathogen pattern recognition receptors」→「Misplaced DNA… can likewise induce antitumor immunity by activating pattern recognition receptors」。
